How to Check Experian Credit Score for Free Online?
Enter your full name, registered mobile number, email ID, and click the ‘submit’ button.
You will receive an OTP on your number. Enter the OTP and click on ‘verify and continue’.
Select your gender and date of birth.
Provide your permanent residential address and include the city, state, and PIN code. Enter your PAN Card details and submit the form.
Once you have provided the required information and authenticated yourself, you can attain your credit report swiftly. You can also get a copy of the report through email.
